name: Respage
positioning: Lead generation, AI leasing and marketing operations built only for multifamily, from first search to renewal.
description: Respage is a marketing and leasing platform aimed at apartment communities. It builds the property websites, runs the paid and organic acquisition around them — search, maps, social advertising, Google Business Profile — and answers the traffic that arrives with a chatbot and an AI leasing agent. A leasing CRM, review solicitation, reputation management, resident surveys and an events module sit on the same account.
real_estate_use: A multifamily operator with a dozen communities usually buys a website vendor, an advertising agency, a chatbot and a reputation tool separately, then discovers that none of them share a lead. Respage is the argument for buying that chain from one place: the ad that produced the enquiry, the bot that answered it at ten at night and the CRM that carries it to a signed lease are the same system. The AI leasing piece is the part that decides the purchase for most teams — prospect volume arrives outside office hours and a leasing office of two people cannot answer it. Marketing agencies serving multifamily are the competition, not other software.
features: AI leasing agent and prospect chatbot
Paid search, social advertising and SEO
Resident surveys and community events module

use_cases.job: Answer prospect enquiries outside leasing office hours
Run acquisition and leasing for several communities on one platform
